// LAYERS_RC_NOTE: Converted from the 2.4.13 flat-string form by tools/setup/librelane3_config.py. Old order was '<layer> <cap> <res>'; 3.0.14 wants a per-IPVT-corner nested mapping with explicit res/cap keys. Values are unchanged ORFS-calibrated ASAP7 numbers.
// UNITS_S9F_1: librelane declares PL/GRT_RESIZER_*_SLACK_MARGIN as units=ns in its schema, but scripts/openroad/rsz_timing_post{cts,grt}.tcl pass the value RAW to OpenROAD, which reads it in the Liberty time_unit. ASAP7 Liberty (asap7sc7p5t_SEQ_RVT_TT_nldm_220123.lib) is time_unit 1ps -- so these are PS values, NOT ns. The old 0.100/0.150 values meant 0.1-0.15 ps (~0 guard band); every prior ASAP7 sign-off (CPU 1282 MHz, GPU, SoC run 14) ran with effectively zero resizer guard band. Proven by GH #96 runs 17/18: 2.5x change in the (misread) margin produced a byte-identical netlist. See claude_verilog_test-s9f.
// UNITS_S9F_2: Values below are real ps, sized at 2.5% of the 780 ps CPU period for setup / 1.5% for hold, rounded to 5 ps, and kept under the current signed-off slack (+24.011 ps setup / +28.142 ps hold at RUN_2026-06-02_20-37-12) so the guard band cannot demand more than this design is known to achieve. PL and GRT stage margins are set equal (the old 100/150 vs 100/100 stage split was never a deliberate ratio -- both were sub-ps and effectively inert). Re-validate on the next real ASAP7 CPU PD run -- not exercised here.

Real ORFS OpenRCX rules now vendored via tools/setup/install_asap7_rcx_rules.py -- see that script's docstring and the bead for geometry-equivalence evidence. // PIN_ORDER_NOTE: FP_PIN_ORDER_CFG pins the macro's boundary pin layout. Without it OpenROAD free-floats pin assignment per block run: two consecutive regenerations moved 393 of 401 pins, which perturbed SoC placement around u_cpu, doubled post-CTS cpu_clk skew (worst_hold -485.6 -> -922.1 ps), drove hold violations 805 -> 4702 endpoints and 4814 inserted hold buffers, and took cpu_clk WNS from -60.66 to -596.00 ps. The file is generated from the known-good run-21 abstract. io_place.py ERRORS if a design pin is missing from the file or vice versa (power/ground are excluded by the tool), so adding a port fails loudly instead of silently reshuffling.
// GRT_ALLOW_CONGESTION_NOTE: Set false for the 3.0.14 routing bring-up (bead ocm). With true, global routing may hand detailed routing a plan it cannot realise; the first ASAP7 run that ever reached detailed routing failed with 16 DRT-0255 maze-route errors concentrated on SRAM macro pins (data_din0/data_dout0/data_gclk) after successfully routing 33905 nets.
// DRT_THREADS_NOTE: Lowered 8 -> 4 on 2026-09-12. DRT_THREADS is a memory multiplier (each TritonRoute worker holds its own routing state). This design peaks ~12.4 GB at 8 threads -- measured on BOTH the PDN-free RUN_2026-09-10_05-13-18 and the first PDN run RUN_2026-09-12_12-07-32, so the peak is design-driven, not caused by the new power grid. On a 15.9 GB host that leaves no headroom and trips systemd-oomd, which kills the whole terminal scope. 4 threads trades runtime for a peak this host can actually hold.
// DENSITY_NOTE: Attempt 10: PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 50 -> 40. Every earlier experiment moved MACROS (channel width, half-worker shift) or changed the abstract; none changed standard-cell density near the macro pins. DRT_THREADS restored to 8 -- single-threaded gave the identical 16 failures, so the count is real and not a parallel-abort artifact.
// DRT_OPT_ITERS_NOTE: Raised 12 -> 30 for the DRC-reduction run (2026-09-09 night). Measured trade-off: DRT_OPT_ITERS=12 gave 12 GiB peak / 3h25m / 2045 DRC and completed write_views; the unbounded 64 gave 13 GiB peak / 8h41m / 43 DRC but died before write_views. At 12 the violation trajectory was still FALLING, not plateaued, so more iterations should buy real DRC reduction. 30 is chosen to stay inside the ~7 h window available and, on the 12-iteration memory curve, to stay under the 13 GiB ceiling that killed the unbounded run. Goal: drive 2045 down while still reaching write_views, so the result is a COMPLETE run.
// LAYERS_RC_M1_NOTE: M1 added 2026-09-09 (bead gyx). LAYERS_RC previously started at M2, so M1 had NO resistance or capacitance on any path -- the ASAP7 tech LEF carries neither attribute for ANY routing layer, and the set_rc.tcl fallback that does include M1 is guarded by ![info exist ::env(LAYERS_RC)] and therefore never fires once LAYERS_RC is set. librelane's irdrop.tcl sources set_rc.tcl (line 19), so LAYERS_RC is exactly what feeds PSM -- which is why analyze_power_grid reported PSM-0021 zero-resistance on M1. Values are ORFS's own (flow/platforms/asap7/setRC.tcl), identical to the other layers' source. NOTE ORFS also has no RESISTANCE in its ASAP7 tech LEF, so supplying R via set_layer_rc is the UPSTREAM-CONSISTENT approach -- do NOT inject resistance into the LEF.
// IR_RUN_NOTE: RUN_IRDROP_REPORT REVERTED to false 2026-09-10. IRDropReport is step 51 of 52 and is FATAL while PSM-0069 stands: RUN_2026-09-10_05-13-18 died there, so final/ was never written and the run produced no final DEF and no final metrics despite clean routing (0 DRT errors). Cost more than it returned. Run IR STANDALONE against a completed run's ODB until PSM-0069 is fixed (bead gyx). The M1 LAYERS_RC addition DID work -- PSM-0021 is gone.
// DIODE_NOTE: ASAP7 SIMPLE HAS NO ANTENNA DIODE. The PDK config sets DIODE_CELL=DECAPx1_ASAP7_75t_R with DIODE_CELL_PIN="" (libs.tech/openlane/asap7sc7p5t_SIMPLE/config.tcl:69-70); DECAPx1 is a decap whose only pins are VDD/VSS. LibreLane 3.0.14 joins the two into 'DECAPx1_ASAP7_75t_R/', and odbpy/diodes.py:248 then does findITerm('') -> None -> AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'connect'. Killed RUN_2026-09-12_10-27-19 at step 42 (odb-diodesonports). Earlier runs never hit it because they were launched with a narrower step set, not because the config differed. Both flags off: there is no cell to insert, so neither step can ever succeed on this PDK. ALSO: repair_antennas itself fails -- antenna_repair.tcl:27 dies with "can't read 'diode_mterm'" because OpenROAD needs a diode PORT and DECAPx1 has none. That killed RUN_2026-09-12_11-03-29 at step 43 (openroad-repairantennas). So RUN_ANTENNA_REPAIR=false and DRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_ITERS=0 too -- the latter matters most: drt.tcl runs the same repair_antennas AFTER detailed routing, which would throw away hours of work. Antenna repair is simply not available on ASAP7 SIMPLE; antenna CHECKING still runs.
